## Description {#details}

<p>Representative of a block.</p>


<p>This is a simple wrapper around an index into the reverse-post-order traversal of the blocks.</p>


<p>Unlike a block pointer, its order has meaning (location in the topological sort) and it's class is the same regardless of block type.</p>
